stem:
A. Use 2 of the triangle tiles to make one large black triangle. Then show what you did with your tiles by shading in your triangle below.

Shade in Your
Triangle Here

[Image: Grid with two squares divided into triangles]

descriptors: [Image: Grid of two squares with the two lower central triangles shaded black to form an upward-pointing triangle] or [Image: Grid of two squares with the two upper central triangles shaded black to form a downward-pointing triangle]
Used two triangle tiles but created two small black triangles
Other incorrect (including crossed out/erased, stray marks, illegible, or off task)

figure_description: A rectangle formed by 2 congruent square sections side-by-side outlined with solid lines. Inside each square, two dotted diagonal lines connect opposite corners, dividing each square into 4 congruent right isosceles triangles, for a total of 8 small triangles.
